csv_project_name: OPM Services for After Dark Building Project
csv_scope_of_work: Northeast Metropolitan Regional Vocational School District ("Owner" or "District") is seeking the services of a qualified Owner's Project Manager ("OPM") as defined in M.G.L. c. 149, 44A1/2 and as further defined by the provisions of this RFQ, to provide OPM Services for the planning, design-build procurement, construction, commissioning, and closeout of the After Dark Building Project at 100 Hemlock Rd., Wakefield, MA ("Project"). The Project consists of the construction of an approximately 10,800 sq. ft. workforce development and technical education facility and parking area consisting of approximately 50 parking spaces
csv_disciplines_requested: Architecture Services, Civil Engineering, Surveying/GIS/Mapping, Construction/Project Management, Inspection Services, Electrical Engineering, Fire Protection Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Structural Engineering, Utility Engineering
